root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `getCipherSuiteID()` may dereference the selected cipher-suite slot, the requested 2-byte entry extent `cipherSuiteStartOffset + sizeof(uint16_t) * (index + 1)` must stay within `m_DataLen`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable guard checks only `cipherSuiteStartOffset + sizeof(uint16_t) > m_DataLen`, which proves at most that entry 0 fits. On the witnessed ClientHello instance the selected `index == 10` slot ends at offset 63 while `m_DataLen == 61`, so the missing per-index extent check is false exactly when the later dereference is reached.

nodes.description: At the AddressSanitizer sink, `getCipherSuiteID()` dereferences the same requested cipher-suite slot pointer selected by the vulnerable guard, via `be16toh(*(cipherSuiteStartPos+index))`.

edges.via: m_Data + cipherSuiteStartOffset + sizeof(uint16_t) * index -> cipherSuiteStartPos + index
edges.relation: The exact requested cipher-suite slot address computed from `m_Data`, `cipherSuiteStartOffset`, and `index` at the guard site is the pointer later dereferenced unchanged as `cipherSuiteStartPos + index` at the sink.
